_note: The input side of stage 3's tests: one fictional claim from ../article.json (the hawker-rents article) and three passages of the kind retrieval would hand it. Every outlet, URL, figure and quotation here is invented. Passage 1 deliberately uses a curly apostrophe where hawker_scores.json quotes a straight one, so the happy path also proves that verification forgives typography and nothing else.

passages.text: The board’s release put the median stall rent adjustment at 4 per cent from 1 January, not the 40 per cent circulating online.
The revised rents take effect on 1 January, the board said in its release. Stallholders were notified by letter in November.
Hawker centres in Singapore are run under a mix of public and private management models, a distinction that rarely surfaces in coverage of rents.
